claims.text: The driver's own platform record trips the anti-farming guard in POL-NS-07. EV-DPROF-00207 records driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d of 7, which is 4 or more, and 7 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 61 works out at 11.5 percent, which is above the 0.08 rate limb. Both limbs of the check are met on this trip's evidence, so this is the second limb of POL-NS-07 engaging, not a borderline call.

Because both limbs of the anti-farming check are met, POL-NS-07 withholds the driver's compensation and routes the case to escalation under POL-NS-09, and it obliges the escalation packet to direct the reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full, precisely so that the rider does not fund a dispute the platform has not resolved. EV-FARE-00207 shows the $4.00 sitting at PENDING with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so nothing has been taken from the rider and the packet instruction is that the $4.00 be returned.

Escalation is the correct disposition and is terminal for the automated pipeline: under POL-NS-09 no monetary ruling issues and the disputed cancellation fee is placed on hold rather than collected or refunded, and under POL-GEN-03 ESCALATE is party-relative - the disputed amount is held. On a rider-filed dispute over a fee still at PENDING, that is the outcome the rider presses for, because the $4.00 stays uncollected while the platform's own integrity question on this driver is open.

The escalation trigger is not built on degraded material. EV-DPROF-00207 is COMPLETE with an empty issues list and weight_multiplier 1.0, so there is no POL-GEN-02 discount to apply to the no-show-termination and completed-trip counters, and the escalation rests on a clean artifact rather than on an impairment of the rider's choosing.

The rider's relief here does not run through POL-NS-06, and I do not stretch it to say otherwise: the driver's own telemetry shows a single continuous qualifying in-geofence run of 507 seconds, 06:41:10 to 06:49:37, against the 300 second STANDARD minimum, so there is no waiting-period shortfall. The route to the rider not carrying this charge is the POL-NS-07 anti-farming escalation, not a dwell finding.

Nor does the rider's case run through POL-NS-04, and I do not pretend it does. EV-CHAT-00207 holds four entries and every one is sent by the SYSTEM or the driver; the rider wrote nothing during the waiting window, so limb (a) of the rider-contact clause - a locating or coordinating message from the rider - is not met, and the rider cannot invoke that exoneration on this record.

claims.text: POL-NS-01 is satisfied on all four limbs, so the cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable and the rider's claim is not supported on the merits. (a) EV-TRIP-00207 records a driver 'arrived' event at 06:41:20. (b) EV-GPS-00207 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD pick-up geofence from 06:41:10, ten seconds before that event. (c) The continuous in-geofence dwell was 507 seconds, exceeding the 300-second STANDARD minimum. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 06:49:37 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, 207 seconds after the required dwell elapsed at 06:46:10.

POL-NS-02's arrival geofence test is comfortably met: the driver's trace holds 52 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, against the three consecutive in-radius fixes the clause requires, and the driver's closest approach to the pin was 14.5 m.

No waiting-period shortfall arises under POL-NS-06: the measured in-geofence dwell is 507 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, a surplus of 207 seconds, so the full-refund route in that clause is not engaged and no refund follows on this footing.

POL-NS-05 does not catch this driver. The 'arrived' event at 06:41:20 lands on a qualifying in-geofence fix, the dwell having begun only 10 seconds earlier at 06:41:10, so the arrival marker is not false, the waiting clock is correctly started, and the corrected dwell is the full 507 seconds.

POL-NS-03's wrong-entrance route cannot apply, because the clause is confined to a driver stationary OUTSIDE the arrival radius; here the driver was inside the 50 m radius for the whole stop, his nearest fix 14.5 m from the pin, so there is no wrong-face-of-the-building case and the 50%-of-fee goodwill payment is not triggered.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider. Its first limb requires a locating or coordinating message FROM the rider in the waiting window, and EV-CHAT-00207 contains none - all four entries are SYSTEM or DRIVER. The driver in any event met the silence directly, messaging 'boss im downstairs at 682' at 06:42:30 and placing an in-app call at 06:45:10 that EV-TRIP-00207 records as unanswered.

Even if limb (a) of POL-NS-04 were met, limb (c) is affirmatively failed on the rider's own track: EV-GPS-00207 places the rider's device a mean 1,900 m from the pin for the whole window with rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0, so the rider was never within the 100 m STANDARD presence radius the clause requires.

The fare line carries no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d): the $4.00 cancellation fee equals the fee_schedule.resolution_rule figure, being the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee ($4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee ($4.00), so there is no basis for down-weighting the fare evidence or for a PARTIAL_REFUND.

EV-ADVIS-00207-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 as the pre-pass records (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), and I disclose that it bears no fact. Its absence does not assist the rider, because the driver's 507-second hold is a single unbroken in-geofence run requiring no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i); a missing advisory merely makes that limb unavailable rather than exonerating anyone.

I must be candid about the driver's remedy rather than assert one the clause forbids. POL-NS-07 would ordinarily pay 80% of the fee - $3.20 of $4.00 - once POL-NS-01 is met and no POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 clause displaces it. But POL-NS-07's anti-farming check is met on this driver's own profile: no_show_terminations_30d is 7 (at or above 4) and 7 divided by completed_trips_30d of 61 is 11.5% (above 8%), so both limbs trip, compensation is WITHHELD and the case routes to escalation under POL-NS-09 with the packet instruction to refund the rider's fee. The fee itself nevertheless remains chargeable on the merits stated above.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: the automated process cannot return your $4.00, but the reason is not that you lose on the fee. On the recorded facts the fee was properly chargeable. The driver arrived at Blk 682 at 06:41:20 and his GPS trace has him inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup geofence from 06:41:10, so the arrival marker is real and not false (POL-NS-05). He then held position continuously for 507 seconds against the 300 second STANDARD minimum (POL-NS-01(c), POL-NS-06), and cancelled at 06:49:37 with the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW (POL-NS-01(d)). Every refund route therefore fails on its own arithmetic: there is no waiting-period shortfall (POL-NS-06), this is not a wrong-entrance case because the driver was 14.5 m from the pin, well inside the 50 m radius rather than outside it (POL-NS-03), and the chat log contains no message from you at all, so POL-NS-04 limb (a) is not met and that clause cannot exonerate you — a point both advocates correctly concede. Your account that you 'did come down' is also contradicted by your own device telemetry, which places you 1.9 km from the pickup with zero qualifying fixes inside the presence radius at any time in the window. I note, but reject, the submission that escalation is the outcome you 'press for' because ESCALATE is party-relative: POL-GEN-03's party-relative language is written for NO_ACTION, and escalation is a hold, not a refund and not a win on the merits.

What changes the disposition is the driver's own platform record, not your evidence. Under POL-NS-07 the driver's compensation is withheld and the case must be escalated where the anti-farming check trips, and it trips on both limbs: 7 no-show terminations in the last 30 days, which is 4 or more, and 7 against 61 completed trips, which is 11.5%, above the 8% rate limb. So no money moves in the automated pipeline: the ruling is ESCALATE, the $4.00 sits at PENDING and is held rather than collected or refunded while a human reviews, and the escalation packet carries POL-NS-07's own instruction to refund your $4.00 in full if the anti-farming concern is not cleared.

To the driver: your claims on the merits are accepted. POL-NS-01 is satisfied on all four limbs (arrived event, in-geofence fixes ten seconds before it, 507 seconds of continuous dwell, and a RIDER_NO_SHOW termination 207 seconds after the dwell elapsed). POL-NS-02 is comfortably met (52 consecutive qualifying in-radius fixes against the three required; nearest approach 14.5 m). POL-NS-05 does not catch you — the marker sits on a qualifying in-geofence fix with the clock starting ten seconds earlier, and the corrected dwell is the full 507 seconds. POL-NS-06 produces no shortfall. POL-NS-03 is inapplicable. POL-NS-08(d) discloses no fare defect: $4.00 is the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, and the fare ledger reconciles. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00207-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries no fact and, because your hold was a single unbroken run, nothing turns on it. But POL-NS-07's anti-farming limb is mandatory, and your profile meets it: compensation of $3.20 is withheld, the case escalates under POL-NS-09, and escalation is terminal, so I cannot emit the DRIVER_COMPENSATION you would otherwise have received. The fee is not written off, but it is also not collected while the review is open.

On weight: the artifacts that carry the deciding facts — EV-TRIP-00207, EV-GPS-00207 and EV-DPROF-00207 — are all COMPLETE with empty issue lists and weight_multiplier 1.0, so no POL-GEN-02 discount applies and confidence is not capped below the 0.70 escalation floor. The only sub-1.0 artifact is the absent advisory at 0.0, which decides nothing. The open question for the reviewer is whether the driver's seven no-show terminations in 30 days reflect genuine failed pickups or fee-farming; that answer decides whether the $4.00 is refunded under POL-NS-07's packet instruction or released to the driver's account.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: the $4.00 no-show fee will not be taken from you while this is open, but I cannot simply hand it back either — the case has to go to a human reviewer, and here is why. To the driver: on the merits your fee was properly earned, but your own record is what blocks payment.

On the merits the driver did everything the no-show rule asks. His trip record shows an 'arrived' event at 06:41:20, and the GPS trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup zone from 06:41:10 — so he was at the pin before he tapped. He then held position inside that zone continuously for 507 seconds (8 min 27 s), well beyond the 5-minute STANDARD minimum, and cancelled only at 06:49:37, some three and a half minutes after the waiting clock ran out, recording RIDER_NO_SHOW. He messaged at 06:42:30 and placed an in-app call at 06:45:10 that went unanswered. All four conditions of POL-NS-01 are therefore met, and POL-NS-02, POL-NS-03, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 all point the same way: there is no geofence failure, no false arrival marker (the marker falls 10 seconds after geofence entry), no wrong-entrance case (the driver's nearest fix was 14.5 m from the pin), and no waiting-period shortfall (507 s against 300 s, a 207 s surplus). The rider's account that she came down shortly after is not supported by her own device's track, which sits about 1.9 km from the pickup pin across the whole waiting window with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m presence radius, and she sent no coordinating message, so POL-NS-04 does not exonerate her. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00207-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 and carries no fact; it does not matter either way, because the driver's hold was a single unbroken run that needed no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i).

What stops the case ending in the driver's favour is POL-NS-07. That clause pays 80% of the fee only if the platform's anti-farming check is clean, and it is not: EV-DPROF-00207 records 7 no-show terminations in the last 30 days against 61 completed trips — 11.5%, over the 0.08 rate limb, with 7 at or above the count limb of 4. Both limbs trip, so compensation is withheld and POL-NS-09 requires escalation.

Under POL-NS-09 the escalation is terminal for the automated pipeline: no money moves, and the disputed $4.00 stays at PENDING — held rather than collected from the rider or refunded to her — while the reviewer examines the driver's pattern. The packet carries POL-NS-07's own instruction that the reviewer refund the rider's cancellation fee in full. Every artifact this ruling rests on is complete at weight 1.0 (trip record, GPS trace, fare breakdown and driver profile), so my confidence is 0.90.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this case is escalated to a human reviewer. The automated pipeline issues no payment and no refund, and the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee stays on hold (fare_breakdown.payment_status is PENDING) — it is not collected from the rider and not returned — while the review is pending.

On the merits the trip record favours the driver. The 'arrived' marker at 06:41:20 lands on a qualifying in-geofence fix; the GPS trace places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD pick-up radius from 06:41:10 with 52 consecutive qualifying fixes; he held position continuously inside the geofence for 507 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum; and the trip was terminated by the driver at 06:49:37 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, more than three minutes after the minimum dwell elapsed at 06:46:10. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold and the $4.00 fee is chargeable on the merits. The rider's account that she came down only a few minutes late is not borne out: her device sat roughly 1.9 km from the pin for the whole window with no qualifying rider fix, and POL-NS-04 does not exonerate her because she sent no locating or coordinating message — all four chat entries are from the system or the driver. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) and POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) do not apply on these facts, and POL-NS-06 produces no shortfall, so no clause displaces POL-NS-01.

The case still cannot close with a money ruling, because the driver's own profile trips POL-NS-07's anti-farming guard: 7 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days (the clause reads 4 or more) across 61 completed trips, a rate of 11.5% against the 8% ceiling. Both limbs are met on clean, weight-1.0 profile evidence. Where both limbs trip, POL-NS-07 withholds the driver's compensation — the $3.20 that would otherwise have been paid is not paid — and sends the case to escalation under POL-NS-09, which is terminal for the automated pipeline and holds the fee rather than collecting or refunding it. The escalation packet carries the POL-NS-07 instruction that the reviewer refund the rider's cancellation fee in full.

The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00207-01, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) is disclosed and carries no fact; it is not needed here, because the driver's 507-second hold was one unbroken in-geofence run that requires no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i). Assessed alone, that would leave the charge standing.

To the driver: that outcome does not issue here, and it is your own record that changes it. POL-NS-07 compensates you at 80% of the fee (SGD 3.20) only if its anti-farming check is clean. ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver.

On the underlying merits the charge was properly raised, so I cannot simply refund it on the facts the rider gives. The driver arrived: the platform trip record shows an 'arrived' event at 06:41:20, and the GPS trace places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD pick-up geofence from 06:41:10, ten seconds before that event. The driver then held position continuously for 507 seconds, from 06:41:10 to 06:49:37, against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, before cancelling with the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. That satisfies POL-NS-01(a) to (d), POL-NS-02, and leaves no shortfall under POL-NS-06 (507 seconds is a 207-second surplus), so the full-refund route in POL-NS-06 is not engaged and POL-NS-05 does not bite because the arrival marker fell on a genuine in-geofence fix rather than a false one. The rider's account that he 'did come down, just a few minutes later' is not supported by his own device track: EV-GPS-00207 places it a mean 1,900 m from the pick-up pin for the whole waiting window, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius. POL-NS-04 (rider contact unanswered by driver) cannot help the rider either: limb (a) needs a locating or coordinating message from the rider, and EV-CHAT-00207 contains none — all four entries are SYSTEM or driver messages — and limb (c) fails independently on the rider track. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) is inapplicable because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not outside it.

What stops a clean charge, though, is the driver's own platform record. POL-NS-07's anti-farming check reads driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d and driver_profile.completed_trips_30d. EV-DPROF-00207 records 7 no-show terminations in 30 days and 61 completed trips. Seven is at or above the threshold of 4, and 7/61 is 11.5 percent, above the 0.08 rate limb. Both limbs therefore trip, so the driver's compensation — which would otherwise have been 80 percent of the fee, SGD 3.20 of SGD 4.00 — is WITHHELD, and the case must escalate under POL-NS-09(d). This is not a finding against the driver on the merits of this trip; it is the platform's guard against a pattern of no-show terminations, and it is a question a human reviewer, not the automated pipeline, must settle. The evidence carrying that conclusion (EV-DPROF-00207, EV-TRIP-00207, EV-GPS-00207, EV-FARE-00207) is all COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0 and the ruling is not near the 0.70 floor; the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00207-01 (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries no fact and is not relied on — the 507-second hold is one unbroken in-geofence run requiring no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i).

What this means in practice: because escalation is terminal, I issue no monetary ruling. The $4.00 cancellation fee is held rather than collected or refunded while the review is pending — EV-FARE-00207 shows it at PENDING with nothing refunded, and that stays as it is for now. The referral above records the instruction POL-NS-07 directs into the escalation packet, namely that the reviewer refund the rider's cancellation fee in full. The open question for the reviewer is the driver's no-show pattern: whether the seven no-show terminations in 30 days reflect genuine rider no-shows or fee-farming, and whether this driver should keep access to no-show cancellation fees.

ledger.claim: The driver's own platform record trips the anti-farming guard in POL-NS-07. EV-DPROF-00207 records driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d of 7, which is 4 or more, and 7 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 61 works out at 11.5 percent, which is above the 0.08 rate limb. Both limbs of the check are met on this trip's evidence, so this is the second limb of POL-NS-07 engaging, not a borderline call.

Because both limbs of the anti-farming check are met, POL-NS-07 withholds the driver's compensation and routes the case to escalation under POL-NS-09, and it obliges the escalation packet to direct the reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full, precisely so that the rider does not fund a dispute the platform has not resolved. EV-FARE-00207 shows the $4.00 sitting at PENDING with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so nothing has been taken from the rider and the packet instruction is that the $4.00 be returned.

Escalation is the correct disposition and is terminal for the automated pipeline: under POL-NS-09 no monetary ruling issues and the disputed cancellation fee is placed on hold rather than collected or refunded, and under POL-GEN-03 ESCALATE is party-relative - the disputed amount is held. On a rider-filed dispute over a fee still at PENDING, that is the outcome the rider presses for, because the $4.00 stays uncollected while the platform's own integrity question on this driver is open.

The escalation trigger is not built on degraded material. EV-DPROF-00207 is COMPLETE with an empty issues list and weight_multiplier 1.0, so there is no POL-GEN-02 discount to apply to the no-show-termination and completed-trip counters, and the escalation rests on a clean artifact rather than on an impairment of the rider's choosing.

The rider's relief here does not run through POL-NS-06, and I do not stretch it to say otherwise: the driver's own telemetry shows a single continuous qualifying in-geofence run of 507 seconds, 06:41:10 to 06:49:37, against the 300 second STANDARD minimum, so there is no waiting-period shortfall. The route to the rider not carrying this charge is the POL-NS-07 anti-farming escalation, not a dwell finding.

Nor does the rider's case run through POL-NS-04, and I do not pretend it does. EV-CHAT-00207 holds four entries and every one is sent by the SYSTEM or the driver; the rider wrote nothing during the waiting window, so limb (a) of the rider-contact clause - a locating or coordinating message from the rider - is not met, and the rider cannot invoke that exoneration on this record.

POL-NS-01 is satisfied on all four limbs, so the cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable and the rider's claim is not supported on the merits. (a) EV-TRIP-00207 records a driver 'arrived' event at 06:41:20. (b) EV-GPS-00207 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD pick-up geofence from 06:41:10, ten seconds before that event. (c) The continuous in-geofence dwell was 507 seconds, exceeding the 300-second STANDARD minimum. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 06:49:37 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, 207 seconds after the required dwell elapsed at 06:46:10.

POL-NS-02's arrival geofence test is comfortably met: the driver's trace holds 52 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, against the three consecutive in-radius fixes the clause requires, and the driver's closest approach to the pin was 14.5 m.

No waiting-period shortfall arises under POL-NS-06: the measured in-geofence dwell is 507 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, a surplus of 207 seconds, so the full-refund route in that clause is not engaged and no refund follows on this footing.

POL-NS-05 does not catch this driver. The 'arrived' event at 06:41:20 lands on a qualifying in-geofence fix, the dwell having begun only 10 seconds earlier at 06:41:10, so the arrival marker is not false, the waiting clock is correctly started, and the corrected dwell is the full 507 seconds.

POL-NS-03's wrong-entrance route cannot apply, because the clause is confined to a driver stationary OUTSIDE the arrival radius; here the driver was inside the 50 m radius for the whole stop, his nearest fix 14.5 m from the pin, so there is no wrong-face-of-the-building case and the 50%-of-fee goodwill payment is not triggered.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider. Its first limb requires a locating or coordinating message FROM the rider in the waiting window, and EV-CHAT-00207 contains none - all four entries are SYSTEM or DRIVER. The driver in any event met the silence directly, messaging 'boss im downstairs at 682' at 06:42:30 and placing an in-app call at 06:45:10 that EV-TRIP-00207 records as unanswered.

Even if limb (a) of POL-NS-04 were met, limb (c) is affirmatively failed on the rider's own track: EV-GPS-00207 places the rider's device a mean 1,900 m from the pin for the whole window with rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0, so the rider was never within the 100 m STANDARD presence radius the clause requires.

The fare line carries no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d): the $4.00 cancellation fee equals the fee_schedule.resolution_rule figure, being the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee ($4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee ($4.00), so there is no basis for down-weighting the fare evidence or for a PARTIAL_REFUND.

EV-ADVIS-00207-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 as the pre-pass records (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), and I disclose that it bears no fact. Its absence does not assist the rider, because the driver's 507-second hold is a single unbroken in-geofence run requiring no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i); a missing advisory merely makes that limb unavailable rather than exonerating anyone.

I must be candid about the driver's remedy rather than assert one the clause forbids. POL-NS-07 would ordinarily pay 80% of the fee - $3.20 of $4.00 - once POL-NS-01 is met and no POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 clause displaces it. But POL-NS-07's anti-farming check is met on this driver's own profile: no_show_terminations_30d is 7 (at or above 4) and 7 divided by completed_trips_30d of 61 is 11.5% (above 8%), so both limbs trip, compensation is WITHHELD and the case routes to escalation under POL-NS-09 with the packet instruction to refund the rider's fee. The fee itself nevertheless remains chargeable on the merits stated above.
